content: Standard IoT ingestion pipeline: device -> ingest API (validate range/rate-of-change) -> write to time-series store (TimescaleDB/InfluxDB) -> pub/sub (Redis pub/sub or in-process EventEmitter) -> WebSocket push to dashboard. Separation of concerns means each stage is replaceable; hot path writes should be decoupled from the websocket broadcast via an event bus so ingestion isn't blocked by slow dashboard clients.
